title: Archetype case catalogue
description: P7.1 model-shape evidence tier. Each entry binds ONE synthetic archetype case to the accounting shape it exercises, the support-envelope dimension values it proves, and the TYPED EXPECTATIONS that make the case meaningful. A case that merely compiles proves nothing: every entry must declare at least one shape_expectation, and the runner must assert each one.

catalogue_group.description: Disjoint authoring group (e.g. economics, presentation). One catalogue file per group; groups never share case files.

archetype_id.description: Stable id, unique across ALL catalogue groups.

case_path.description: Repo-relative. NEVER test-fixtures/cases/ — that directory is globbed by other suites and its derived donor is hash-pinned.

why_it_breaks_models.description: The specific failure a naive implementation would produce on this shape.

proves_envelope_values.description: Support-envelope {dimension, value} pairs this case is claimed to prove. May be empty for archetypes outside the declared envelope — those are recorded as envelope_extension_candidate.

envelope_extension_candidate.description: True when the shape is real but the envelope declares no dimension value for it — a claim-set gap, recorded not silently dropped.

shape_expectations.description: What the runner asserts. Each expectation must be checkable against a compiled artifact, not prose.

expected_terminal_reason.description: Required when kind is typed_refusal or unsupported_profile_early_stop: the registered reason code the case must produce.

extraction_evidence_still_required.description: True when the synthetic case proves the ECONOMICS but a real filing is still needed to prove the product can READ this shape. Keeps the two evidence tiers honest.
